basis: Inline inspection of first baseline outputs and saved HTTP bodies, before changing crawler source. Original topic checks remain unchanged. These additional checks expose four false positives in those original checks.

react.reason: A serialized component tree contains the topic words but is not readable extracted prose.

mathworld.reason: The target page's defining equation must survive. Its image alternative text exists in the saved source.

coursera.reason: The initial result is a truncated 499-character description. The source also contains course structure and instructors.

ikea.reason: The specified product redirects to a category listing. Matching BILLY keywords does not recover that product. Keep this unavailable target in the denominator.

warnings.stanford: Main article is present but output includes navigation and bibliography.
warnings.mit-ocw: Course information is present but some repeated navigation and footer text remains.
warnings.wikipedia-fr: Main article is present with editorial notices and category text.
warnings.musicbrainz: Homepage content is present with substantial navigation.
